name: Morpho Vault V2: Steakhouse Prime USDC (Ethereum L1)

requirements.label: Admin power is not a bare key
A confirmed delay before changes apply, no bypass
Bypass paths of the delay checked and ruled out
Price feed not under one hand
No key shared with another tracked protocol

exit_window: a confirmed delay, bypass paths checked

narrative.summary: The owner is a VaultV2Supervisor whose owner is Steakhouse's 5-of-10 Safe, the same Safe that owns four of the Morpho V1 vaults tracked here; the curator is a 3-of-9 Safe. Every fund-redirecting action sits behind a 7-day timelock, and several exit gates are permanently abdicated.
narrative.detail: Pushed on-chain 2026-10-10. Scored 70 / 75 / 75 with an oracle-authority score of 52, the weakest controller among the price paths that carry at least 1% of the vault: a Chainlink proxy owner, a 4-of-9 Safe with no timelock above it. The send-assets gate is the one exit gate not abdicated: the curator controls it behind a 7-day timelock. The sister vault Steakhouse Prime EURCV has the same owner and curator Safes.
